title: Industrial Designer - Entry Level
note: 3D printer hardware; needs an ID degree and a portfolio.

facts.summary: Entry-level industrial designer on the hardware team for Formlabs 3D printers.
facts.duties: Takes products from concept to production: sketching, prototyping, user testing, CAD and cosmetic specs.
facts.requirements: ID degree, strong sketching, 3D CAD, KeyShot and Adobe CC skills, and some feel for manufacturing constraints.
facts.apply: Apply on Formlabs' Greenhouse page and include a portfolio.
